macos_ordinary_binary_comparison.conclusion: All observed original-byte differences lie within each executable's declared Mach-O code-signature storage. See the independently parsed image, UUID, load-command, section and CodeDirectory comparisons. The complete original executables remain distinct; no normalized executable was produced. The only CodeDirectory field changes are its output-basename identifier, identifier length, hash-table offset and blob length; the code-page hashes are unchanged.
